title: ALAIN COLMERAUER L'AVENTURE PROLOG
summary: A French-language documentary on the history of Prolog, created in Marseille by Alain Colmerauer in the early 1970s, with interviews of many people involved. It traces the origins of logic programming and later developments of the language.
why: Cited in Prolog threads as a rare documentary on the language's origins, with proper subtitles despite being in French.

quote.text: A recently released documentary talks a bit about these developments
